newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 16.

text.p: The following story was reported in Wednesday's Daily Variety:

NEW YORK - Andy Vajna's Cinergi Pictures Entertainment is discussing a possible merger with Mike Medavoy's Phoenix Pictures. The discussions are at an early stage and Cinergi is believed to have at least another potential buyer. Cinergi's attempts to work out a merger with New Regency Enterprises and acquisition by Walt Disney Co began and ended over the summer.
